description: Look closer at an image the designer attached in the chat (e.g. a survey map) to place points precisely. Attached images arrive labelled "Image 1", "Image 2"…; each is a view ("1") in the pixels you see. Returns a close-up of the full-size original around a point of a view, as a new view ("1.1", "1.2"…) with its own pixels. Points for set_survey_map and map_to_garden are given on any view. Only in the editor's own chat, where images are attached.

size.description: Side of the region in that view's pixels (default 200)

view.description: The image ("1") or an earlier close-up ("1.2")

x.description: Centre of the close-up, pixels from the left of that view

y.description: Centre of the close-up, pixels from the top of that view

name: zoom_image
